 "data": "erDiagram

 %% ============================================================
 %% OCB IDENTITY
 %% ============================================================

 OCB_CUSTOMER {
 BIGINT ocb_customer_id PK
 }

 OCB_CUSTOMER_IDENTITY {
 BIGINT ocb_customer_id FK
 string source_entity PK
 string source_customer_id PK
 datetime created_at
 }


 %% ============================================================
 %% ANANSE TELECOM
 %% ============================================================

 ANANSE_CUSTOMER {
 string customer_id PK
 string first_name
 string last_name
 date date_of_birth
 string nationality
 string occupation
 string phone_number
 string email
 datetime created_at
 }

 ANANSE_TRANSACTION {
 string transaction_id PK
 string customer_id FK
 BIGINT wallet_id FK
 BIGINT transaction_status_id FK
 BIGINT transaction_type_id FK
 BIGINT transaction_channel_id FK
 BIGINT currency_id FK
 datetime transaction_timestamp
 string transaction_location
 string device_id
 decimal amount
 }

 WALLET {
 BIGINT wallet_id PK
 string customer_id FK
 }


 %% ============================================================
 %% SIKACREDIT
 %% ============================================================

 SIKACREDIT_CUSTOMER {
 string customer_id PK
 string first_name
 string last_name
 date date_of_birth
 string nationality
 string occupation
 string phone_number
 string email
 datetime created_at
 }

 SIKACREDIT_LOAN {
 string loan_id PK
 string customer_id FK
 datetime disbursement_timestamp
 string disbursement_location
 date maturity_date
 decimal principal_amount
 decimal interest_rate
 string currency
 }

 SIKACREDIT_REPAYMENT {
 string repayment_id PK
 string loan_id FK
 decimal repayment_amount
 datetime repayment_timestamp
 string repayment_location
 }


 %% ============================================================
 %% OMAN REMIT
 %% ============================================================

 OMAN_REMIT_CUSTOMER {
 string customer_id PK
 string first_name
 string last_name
 date date_of_birth
 string nationality
 string occupation
 string phone_number
 string email
 datetime created_at
 }

 OMAN_REMIT_REMITTANCE {
 string remittance_id PK
 string customer_id FK
 BIGINT country_id FK
 string remittance_status
 datetime remittance_timestamp
 string transaction_location
 decimal amount
 string currency
 string transaction_channel
 }


 %% ============================================================
 %% LEDGER / FINANCIAL CORE
 %% ============================================================

 FINANCIAL_EVENT {
 BIGINT financial_event_id PK
 string source_entity
 string source_event_id
 string event_type
 datetime event_timestamp
 string event_status
 }

 FINANCIAL_CONSEQUENCE {
 BIGINT financial_consequence_id PK
 BIGINT financial_event_id
 string consequence_type
 decimal amount
 string currency
 BIGINT wallet_id
 string customer_id
 }

 LEDGER_ENTRY {
 BIGINT ledger_entry_id PK
 BIGINT financial_consequence_id
 BIGINT financial_event_id
 string transaction_id
 BIGINT wallet_id
 string account_reference
 string entry_type
 decimal amount
 string currency
 datetime entry_timestamp
 }


 %% ============================================================
 %% REFERENCE DATA
 %% ============================================================

 TRANSACTION_TYPE {
 BIGINT transaction_type_id PK
 string transaction_type_code
 string transaction_type_name
 }

 TRANSACTION_STATUS {
 BIGINT transaction_status_id PK
 string transaction_status_code
 string transaction_status_name
 }

 TRANSACTION_CHANNEL {
 BIGINT transaction_channel_id PK
 string transaction_channel_code
 string transaction_channel_name
 }

 CURRENCY {
 BIGINT currency_id PK
 string currency_code
 string currency_name
 }

 COUNTRY {
 BIGINT country_id PK
 string country_code
 string country_name
 }


 %% ============================================================
 %% FOREIGN-KEY RELATIONSHIPS — PHYSICAL DEPLOYMENT
 %% ============================================================

 OCB_CUSTOMER ||--o{ OCB_CUSTOMER_IDENTITY : \"resolves\"

 ANANSE_CUSTOMER ||--o{ WALLET : \"owns\"
 ANANSE_CUSTOMER ||--o{ ANANSE_TRANSACTION : \"performs\"

 WALLET ||--o{ ANANSE_TRANSACTION : \"records\"

 TRANSACTION_TYPE ||--o{ ANANSE_TRANSACTION : \"classifies\"
 TRANSACTION_STATUS ||--o{ ANANSE_TRANSACTION : \"classifies\"
 TRANSACTION_CHANNEL ||--o{ ANANSE_TRANSACTION : \"classifies\"
 CURRENCY ||--o{ ANANSE_TRANSACTION : \"denominates\"

 SIKACREDIT_CUSTOMER ||--o{ SIKACREDIT_LOAN : \"holds\"
 SIKACREDIT_LOAN ||--o{ SIKACREDIT_REPAYMENT : \"receives\"

 OMAN_REMIT_CUSTOMER ||--o{ OMAN_REMIT_REMITTANCE : \"initiates\"
 COUNTRY ||--o{ OMAN_REMIT_REMITTANCE : \"originates_from\"",
